## Hi, I'm Alexis! {#about .glass}

#### Computational Scientist | Bioinformatics | Genomics

I design and implement production-ready bioinformatics and computational biology workflows in Python and R that translate complex genomics and molecular datasets into reliable, interpretable results. My work bridges experimental biology and scalable computational systems, with a focus on data quality, performance evaluation, and reproducible analysis across technologies, cohorts, and conditions.
